Orange Tulip Scholarship India 2022-23 is a combined initiative of Nuffic's Netherlands Education Support Office (NESO), India and Tilburg University for postgraduate applicants. The Orange Tulip Scholarship Program (OTS) gives talented students in India the opportunity to study in the Netherlands with a partial tuition fee waiver. Tilburg University offers four of these scholarships. The scholarship beneficiaries receive a partial tuition fee waiver to pay a tuition fee of € 4,530.
To be eligible, the applicants must:
have a degree from a non-Dutch university
have excellent study results in bachelor's (or master's) degree program*
be undergoing the admission process or be already admitted to a one-year master’s program at Tilburg University
have not previously studied or worked in the Netherlands
As an indication, the candidate must have graduated (or can prove that is going to graduate) with an average result of at least 80% or must be among the 10% of their class.
The scholarship beneficiaries receive a partial tuition fee waiver to pay a tuition fee of € 4,530.

NESO India will review the applications and forward applicants’ details to the scholarship coordinator at Tilburg University.
The scholarship coordinator will coordinate the selection of scholarship recipients* and inform them regarding the awards by mid-May 2023.
The successful applicants must confirm acceptance of the scholarship after selection.

*Note - During the selection procedure, preference will be given to applicants who are either unconditionally admitted to a master’s program or those whose graduation is the only outstanding admission condition.
Applicants currently living in the Netherlands, including Tilburg University pre-master's students accepted onto a master’s program will not be considered for this scholarship;
Incomplete forms and packages will not be taken into account.
